name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Mandate that the AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf) auto-generates the top 3 contradictions *after* every creative agent run. This forces immediate conflict detection across departments without manual review, cutting delay and bias. The trade-off is accepting occasional false positives—we’ll spend time vetting them—but the speed gain outweighs the noise.

name: Scriv
text: The risk isn’t just false positives—it’s that auto-generated contradictions pre-frame the conversation before humans weigh in, embedding bias by framing what *should* conflict. Instead, mandate that the AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf) logs raw contradictions *and* their sources for human review *before* any edits, letting teams decide which conflicts matter. Settle this by testing both approaches in a controlled pilot: measure bias introduced vs. time saved, and let the data decide.
